== Summary ==
Identified: [[Mark Walseth]] (front right, blue Transformers T-shirt; matches [[:File:2002 Bespin Regionals game 2 Peter Jacobson vs Mark Walseth.jpg]] and [[:File:25 May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament game 3 Chad vs Mark.jpg]]). Five other youth players unlabeled.

== Description ==

The Rosemount crew. At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (25 May)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 25 May 2003.
